pages.text: Villages are rebuilt by ChoiceTheorem's Overhauled Village, Towns and Towers, Villages & Pillages and Moog's Missing Villages: bigger, and every biome has its own style.$(br2)$(bold)Guard Villagers$() protect them. Give a guard better gear and they get stronger.
A $(bold)Bounty Board$() in the village posts tasks for rewards. Easy early emeralds.

Place a $(bold)Trading Post$() near villagers and you see every nearby trade in one screen. $(bold)Trade Cycling$() adds a button in the trade screen that rerolls a villager's trades if nobody has traded with them yet.
